findings.evidence: 128-node default GPU-gated per-edge medians are 3051.59 / 3899.46 / 3194.96 ns for 0 / 1000 / 10000 ns requested synthetic bodies.
A device-resident mapped-memory gate with system-scope release/acquire was separately measured; driver/batch pulses remain.
Default / PDL effective-body gaps are about 0.51 / 0.37 microseconds in this synthetic family; first-node dispatch and mixed copy boundaries are not measured by these values.
Traced replay event time is 40.64% to 53.57% higher for tested zero-body pure/mixed chains than paired untraced control.
Pure PDL traced replay inter-kernel gap median is -42.62 ns; negative cost cannot be injected into serial physical execution.
All results remain prediction_qualified=false; measurements are diagnostics and holdout counterexamples.

findings: Long-chain255-node error changed from-12.86% to-0.57% without parameter changes; CPU environment materially affected that failure.
Alternating and shuffled mixed-body error is now+10.52%/+5.80%, so low CPU contention does not establish general queue-model correctness.
Observer on/off device-event medians differ+7.23%/+10.07%; separate-process controls do not isolate observer effect from all run-order/graphics variation, and cannot prove negligible perturbation.
